reason: I'm not letting an AI answer my customers when I can't see exactly what it says or whether it hooks into the booking and invoicing tools I actually use. 'CRM, Google, Microsoft' tells me nothing about my setup, and one wrong answer to a client costs me more than the subscription.
objection: It probably doesn't connect to my specific tools, and I don't trust an AI replying to customers or touching their data without me approving every message. 'GDPR-compliant' on a landing page isn't proof.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own tools showing every AI reply goes to me for approval first, plus a clear statement of where my data is stored in the EU and a list of the exact integrations.
